units: gas in TGas, amounts in yoctoNEAR (strings)
notes: prepaid_gas is the value to attach; unused gas is refunded to the signer.
Methods with a Treasury call chain need 300 TGas: the callbacks are pre-allocated (SPEC 6a).
Goal methods reject any attached deposit except `deposit` (payable).
The goal never receives a bond: the challenger pays it to the Treasury with deposit_bond.

new.note: init; deployed in one transaction: create-account + transfer + deploy + new

deposit.note: payable; counted as fees by sync

challenge.note: free challenge, only when treasury is null

resolve_timeout.note: 30 is enough when treasury is null; with treasury it calls Treasury refund_expired (100) + callback (15)

qualify.chain: qualified=true: none; false: authorize_decision 35 + on_decided 125 (settle_bond 100 + on_settled 15)

refund_expired.note: fallback: unbound bond after bind_until_ns, or bound bond after refund_after_ns

retry_failed_refund.note: only when the Treasury bond status is RefundRetryable

bond.F: locked * weight_bps / 10000 at prepare_challenge time (locked = total_received - immediate)
bond.R: min(F / 10, B / 2, 2 NEAR); passed to the Treasury only, no reward is paid

deadlines_release.time_units: case deadlines are nanoseconds (u64 JSON numbers); milestone times are milliseconds

storage.new_min_balance_approx_3_milestones: ≈ 2.56 NEAR (code 214115 bytes ≈ 2.14 NEAR + state + 0.4 NEAR reserve)
storage.funding_note: 3 NEAR covers the maximum-size goal (5 milestones, strings at the limit), checked in tests/integration.rs
storage.growth_measured_bytes: 13015 (5 proofs + 5 bonded requests, strings at the limit); claim never pays out the 20000-byte reserve
